creative_brief.emotional_promise: A tiny, warm moment of surprise: one simple roll makes the sleepy owl visibly change its footing.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A compact double-sided card keeps setup on the front and the complete play, reset, troubleshooting, care, and safety sequence on the back without requiring a screen.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-page 7 x 5 inch landscape owner card for double-sided printing.
teaching_arc: Identify the owl body and removable chick cam.
Place both upright on a level table and seat the chick at the left stop.
Use one thumb to roll the chick right while keeping the owl upright.
Watch one foot lift and the other foot settle.
Roll the chick back to the left stop to reset.
Reseat on a clean level surface if the parts bind or slide.
Lift out the chick, wipe both parts dry, and store them together.
typography: Vera Bold for compact display headings and action labels
Vera Regular for concise owner instructions
creative_brief.visual_motif: Rounded nest-like panels, broad owl geometry, and a single directional rail echo the toy's soft silhouette and left-to-right cam motion.

findings: The first render required more explicit thumb contact and left-to-right endpoint cues for a first-time owner.
The middle state needed to name the visible foot lift rather than only describing the hidden cam mechanism.
resolved_changes: Added LEFT STOP and RIGHT STOP labels directly beneath the directional rail and changed the middle action to THUMB: ROLL RIGHT.
Changed the middle state caption to Watch one foot lift while retaining the final other-foot-settles cue.
